data.body: Note on local full-suite runs in this session: the first run exited 1 with `12625 passed, 60 skipped, 6 errors`, and all six were teardown trips of the `_no_repo_commits` autouse guard — `Test moved the repo HEAD (c6828ef348 -> 3dc51aa26d)`. That transition is my own `git commit` landing while the suite was in flight, not a test defect: zero tests FAILED. Recording it because the signature is easy to misread as a real regression, and the same artifact will appear in any run overlapped with a commit or amend in the same worktree. The remedy is simply not to commit while a local full-suite run is open; CI runs against a pristine checkout and is unaffected.
